name: rmc-bestfit
description: Statistical analysis and plotting with RMC-BestFit: run supported flood frequency workflows and visualize saved model results.

interface.longDescription: Analyze hydrologic data and visualize RMC-BestFit statistical results for engineers and researchers. Research flood evidence, run supported flood frequency workflows through the local BestFit API, compare estimates and uncertainty, and render saved frequency, chronology, bivariate, rating-curve, time-series, regression and diagnostic plots. New analyses require compatible BestFit source, .NET 10, Python, a persistent process and loopback access. Saved-result plotting uses Python and supplied results; it does not fit missing models. Engineering decisions remain with the user.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use RMC-BestFit to analyze flood evidence or visualize supplied statistical results, preserving source data and uncertainty.
